sourceModificationScope: A copy of the licensed simple Pages fixture was edited in native Pages. Default paragraph style uses 1.5 relative line spacing and a 180-point left tab. The next paragraph overrides both with 2.0 spacing and a 216-point tab; the third explicitly resets spacing to 1.0 and clears custom tabs. A level-zero, non-tiered decimal list starts at 7, continues at 8, restarts at 3 and continues at 4.

exportOptions.pdf: Best image quality, comments, annotations and password disabled.

license: Derivative of the nim-iwork MIT fixture, copyright Alfred. Original attribution is retained in IWorkCorpus/README.md.
fontProvenance: Installed macOS Times 12-point text. The source PostScript name is Times-Roman. Native DOCX lists use the exporter fallback Arial Unicode MS; no standalone font files are distributed.
qualification: Native saved source and independent DOCX/PDF exports pin positive inherited/overriding relative spacing and custom tabs, explicit empty resets, and level-zero non-tiered decimal starts/restarts with contiguous continuation. The native screenshot and complete one-page PDF were inspected.

Strict saved/reopened DOCX checks compare all paragraph text in order, effective line spacing and tab stops, native start overrides 7 and 3, and the 393-twip paragraph and numbering-level hanging offset. Reader blocks and Markdown retain all four decimal counters.

Pages 15.4 reopens the OfficeIMO DOCX without repair or font warnings. Its complete one-page PDF and screenshot were inspected. All 24 extracted word bounds match Apple DOCX reimport exactly, and differ from the original native PDF by at most 0.01364 points, reflecting twentieth-point quantization. This qualifies the selected paragraph/list fixture, fonts and renderer.

Other levels, tiered counters, numbering scripts, continuation across non-list text, mixed marker font sizes and interacting indents remain unqualified. Full document appearance, other containers and other producer versions require their own native evidence.
